items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: With Thad Jones and Mel Lewis, like we talked about, things changed.

ctx.x: What’s your favorite format to play? © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

Trio. Definitely trio. Small groups. Trio, duo, quartet, solo. Because when I started playing piano it was not so interesting to play big band piano — Count Basie or something. With Thad Jones and Mel Lewis, like we talked about, things changed. Because then the rhythm section was so central in the big band. So then I started to play the piano. But I had already made my choice. But I mean to organize a big band, I wouldn’t dream of it. I mean it needs some special capacities to do that. I’m not that kind of guy.…
Because you get to play either by choice or by necessity with different bassists and drummers —
